item.title: How does daylight saving time affect our bodies? WVU professor weighs in
item.description: This Sunday is daylight saving time, clocks will ‘spring forward’ and evenings will have more daylight come summertime. But not everyone is a fan of this annual shift.

item.title: Pierpont Community & Technical College holds final open forum in search of next president
item.description: For the past three days, Pierpont Community and Technical College has hosted open forums to find its next president, a process that wrapped up on Friday with an interview with current interim president Michael Waide.

item.title: WVU Bridgeport Nursing Students take pledge during Spring ceremony
item.description: Students at the West Virginia University School of Nursing Bridgeport Campus formally entered the nursing profession during the Spring 2026 Nursing Pledge Ceremony on Thursday, marking a significant milestone in their academic careers.

item.title: Hulu announces Skylar Neese docuseries: How to watch
item.description: It's been nearly 15 years since the murder of Morgantown girl Skylar Neese, and now, the murder case that gripped north central West Virginia will be revisited in a three-part documentary series on Hulu.

item.title: Community organization in Lewis County raises money for new emergency vehicle
item.description: Lewis County First, a community organization, has raised enough money through donors to purchase a new emergency response vehicle that will be used by Lewis County EMS as well as Lewis County Athletics to provide safe and reliable transport to those in need.

item.title: Braxton County couple pleads guilty after infant dies from alcohol poisoning
item.description: A Braxton County couple has pleaded down to voluntary manslaughter charges after a report revealed that their infant daughter had a fatal amount of alcohol in her system when she died in November 2024.

item.title: Clarksburg Visitors Bureau Board voices concerns over possible regional takeover
item.description: Officials with the Clarksburg Visitors Bureau (CVB) are voicing their concerns over a proposal by city leaders that would place the bureau under the authority of a regional tourism organization, a move they fear could diminish the city’s unique identity and historic character.

item.title: Man allegedly choked Mon County deputy by putting them in 'a headlock'
item.description: A man has been arrested and is facing charges in Monongalia County after deputies say he placed one of them in a headlock and choked them following a foot pursuit.

item.title: Preston County community rallies to save struggling Tunnelton Quik Stop
item.description: Earlier this week, dozens of businesses in Preston County began offering incentives for customers who show proof of purchase from the Tunnelton Quik Stop, as the business struggles to attract customers due to lengthy roadwork.

item.title: Upshur County pair allegedly locked non-verbal child in room covered in food, feces
item.description: Two people have been charged after allegedly locking a young, non-verbal child in a room at an Upshur County residence that was covered in food and feces.
